verdict.rationale: Copilot documents its own non-interactive agent execution through cloud-agent Automations, which run on a schedule or in response to repository events. It also has an official CLI for terminal use. However, nothing shows the CLI can be invoked headlessly from a script, and Automations are event/schedule triggers rather than script-invoked runs. missing for 10: documented non-interactive/headless CLI mode (prompt flags, auto-approval, machine-readable output), evidence of invoking the agent from shell scripts or CI, hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can run the agent non-interactively in scripts for workflow automation

citations.quote: Automations let you run Copilot cloud agent automatically, on a schedule or in response to events in a repository.
Set up an automation to run Copilot automatically, on a schedule or in response to events such as an issue being opened.
The command-line interface (CLI) for GitHub Copilot allows you to use Copilot directly from your terminal.
